items.exampleEn: The pine in our yard stays green even in winter.
items.exampleZh: 我們院子裡那棵松樹連冬天都是綠的。

items.exampleEn: The cat climbed up the trunk of the tall tree.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓爬上了大樹的樹幹。

items.exampleEn: This wilderness is home to rare plants that grow nowhere else.
items.exampleZh: 這片荒野生長著別處沒有的稀有植物。
items.glossZh: 荒野；未開發的自然地區

items.exampleEn: The red barn behind the house is full of hay and old tools.
items.exampleZh: 房子後面的紅色穀倉裡堆滿了乾草和舊工具。

items.exampleEn: Wolves usually live and look for food in groups.
items.exampleZh: 狼通常成群生活和覓食。

items.exampleEn: Some weeds have pretty yellow flowers.
items.exampleZh: 有些雜草會開漂亮的黃花。

items.exampleEn: After the fire went out, we covered the hot ash with sand.
items.exampleZh: 火熄滅後，我們用沙子蓋住熱灰。

items.exampleEn: The goats climbed easily up the rocky hill to find fresh grass.
items.exampleZh: 山羊輕鬆爬上多石的山坡，尋找新鮮的草。

items.sentenceEn: The old tree has a trunk so thick that three people can't get their arms around it.
items.sentenceZh: 那棵老樹的樹幹粗到三個人都抱不住。

items.audioEn: Please lock the barn door tonight; I think a fox has been taking our eggs.
items.audioZh: 今晚請把穀倉門鎖上，我覺得有狐狸在偷我們的蛋。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要鎖穀倉門？
options: The goats keep getting out at night
A fox may be stealing eggs

items.sentenceEn: Our neighbor keeps two goats that give fresh milk every day.
items.sentenceZh: 我們鄰居養了兩隻山羊，每天都有新鮮的羊奶。

items.sentenceEn: In many old stories, the wolf is the clever enemy of the farmer.
items.sentenceZh: 在許多古老的故事裡，狼是農夫聰明的敵人。

items.stemEn: The volcano covered the nearby villages in a thick layer of gray ____.
items.stemZh: 火山讓附近的村莊蓋上一層厚厚的灰色火山灰。

items.stemEn: If you don't pull them out, ____ will soon take over the whole garden.
items.stemZh: 如果不拔掉，雜草很快就會長滿整個花園。

items.passageEn: My aunt and uncle left the suburbs to live on a small farm at the edge of the wilderness. Tall pine trees surround their land, and the air always smells fresh. They keep six goats in an old barn, and every morning my aunt makes cheese from their milk. Life is not always easy. Weeds grow quickly in the summer, and in winter they sometimes hear a wolf near the hills. Last year, lightning hit a tree during a storm, and its huge trunk fell across the road. After they burned the branches, my uncle used the ash in the garden to help the plants grow.
items.passageZh: 我阿姨和姨丈離開郊區，搬到荒野邊緣的一座小農場。高大的松樹環繞著他們的土地，空氣總是很清新。他們在一座舊穀倉裡養了六隻山羊，阿姨每天早上都用羊奶做起司。生活並不總是輕鬆。夏天雜草長得很快，冬天有時還會聽到山丘附近有狼。去年，一場暴風雨中閃電打中一棵樹，巨大的樹幹倒下橫在路上。他們把樹枝燒掉後，姨丈把灰撒在菜園裡，幫助植物生長。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨每天早上用羊奶做什麼？
姨丈怎麼處理燒樹枝留下的灰？

items.promptZh: 我們在後車廂放了兩個大行李箱。
referenceEn: We put two big suitcases in the trunk.
There are two large suitcases in the trunk of our car.
rubricZh: trunk 在這裡指汽車後車廂（例如 in the trunk）

items.promptZh: 他們在荒野中迷路了兩天才被找到。
referenceEn: They were lost in the wilderness for two days before they were found.
They got lost in the wilderness and were found two days later.
rubricZh: wilderness 指荒野（例如 in the wilderness 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 were lost、got lost、were found、have been found 等）
「兩天才被找到」可寫，例如 for two days before…、were found two days later 等
